## Scope check

`pfl` is read-only and static: it never executes the runtime, tools, skills,
hooks, or MCP servers, and it does not score output quality or optimize a
harness. If your request needs execution or inference beyond what a static
inspection can support, say so and it is still useful to record as deferred.
